subject.title: feat(message): list chat / list messages should support pagination instead of hardcoded 25 limit

question: Should OpenClaw define one shared message-action pagination contract now, or split the remaining work into provider-specific pagination follow-ups?
rationale: Source inspection proves the remaining gap, but choosing the permanent cursor/page-token shape across offset-based Discord search and token/nextLink providers is a product/API decision rather than a safe autonomous repair.

options.title: Define Shared Contract
options.body: Add a shared message-action pagination response/input contract and implement the highest-impact provider paths behind that contract.

options.title: Split By Provider
options.body: Keep this issue as planning context and create narrower follow-ups for Discord search offset, Teams Graph nextLink, and Feishu pageToken behavior.

options.title: Close Scope At Display Fix
options.body: Accept https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99089 as the intended product boundary and close the broader cursor/page iteration request as not planned.

recommendation.title: Define Shared Contract
recommendation.body: Add a shared message-action pagination response/input contract and implement the highest-impact provider paths behind that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: This person reopened the issue after the partial fix and described the remaining product boundary.
